subject: Furniture around fireplaces and alcoves
hook: Can furniture go next to a working log burner?
fb:
A good question for the start of March, when the log burner is still on most evenings: can you have fitted furniture right next to a working fire?

Usually, yes — but it has to be planned. Our furniture is made from engineered board, which is combustible, so it needs to sit outside the clearance zone your stove or fire's installation manual sets out. We ask to see that at the survey and design the alcove units around it.

If you're not sure what your fire needs, the person who installed it can confirm. Got a question about your own alcoves? Ask below, or book a free consultation.

gbp:
Can you have fitted alcove units next to a working fire or log burner? Usually, yes — with the right planning.

SUPERIO furniture is made from engineered board (MFC and MDF), which is combustible, so units need to sit outside the clearance zone set out in your stove or fire's installation instructions. At the survey we'll ask about your fire, look at the manual if you have it, and design the alcove units, shelving or TV storage to respect those distances.

If you're unsure what your appliance needs, the installer who fitted it can confirm before we begin. We design and build made-to-measure alcove furniture for homes across Stoke-on-Trent and Staffordshire, made in our own workshop in Hanley and fitted by our own team.

Book a free, no-obligation consultation to talk through your room.
